model.title: Lower Colorado River Multi-Species Conservation Program Amendment Act of 2025
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. Alex Padilla (D-CA)

summary.text: The bill would create an interest-bearing account to hold nonfederal contributions to a multi-state conservation program in Arizona, California, and Nevada that works to protect species listed as endangered under federal law. The measure aims to improve how funding is managed for this cooperative effort between federal and nonfederal partners.
